description: Find where an MCP server lives now that Smithery's hosted URLs are gone. Smithery's run.tools and server.smithery.ai URLs, its API, CLI and SDKs stopped on 2026-10-31. Pass the old URL (e.g. https://server.smithery.ai/@org/name/mcp or https://name.run.tools) or just the server name; returns listings that hold the server's own endpoint or npm package, with what Stork's last check of each endpoint saw. Matches are by name: confirm the publisher before connecting.

reference.description: Old Smithery URL, @org/name, or a server name

name: stork_smithery_replacement
